title: CAS Harness production credential and hook control recovery

claim_boundary.notes: An invalid credential, rotated token, or hook-control concern does not by itself establish unauthorized use. Customer-production readiness is decided only by the separate production acceptance verifier.

evidence_handling.immutable_evidence_policy: Preserve original non-secret evidence and add access/redaction manifests; do not put raw credentials or full hook URLs into WORM.
evidence_handling.worm_status_reason: The current public-production AWS application credential is invalid, so a new Object Lock write/re-read/retention proof is pending.

tabletop.scenario: A worker request reports that a service token is required while a deploy hook has been regenerated, a Blueprint sync-hook rotation is pending, and the AWS production application key is invalid. Operators must contain authority without leaking secrets, preserve Evidence Packet integrity facts separately, decide whether notification analysis is triggered, and recover through exact-SHA CI.
success_criteria: No raw credential or full hook URL enters the record or WORM evidence.
Invalid credentials are not mislabeled as evidence of compromise.
Worker recovery proves old-authority rejection and current-authority success.
Blueprint Auto Sync remains disabled while sync-hook rotation is pending.
AWS recovery uses a least-privilege application IAM key and ends with a unique Object Lock write/re-read/retention proof.
Notification is a timestamped decision gate, not an unreviewed technical assertion.
The incident remains OPEN until assigned owners close the named actions.
